plannerPolicy: Planner and cycle rows are role-space scoped and private by default. Only explicit per-record sharing enters bounded character-mode snapshots; raw mode excludes all. Generic inexact notifications contain no role, title, note, period or chat text, and no exact-alarm permission is requested.
limitations: Static APK entry scan in UTF-8 and UTF-16LE. Device database, WAL, cache, Keystore files, SQLCipher upgrade, notification delivery, boot rescheduling, UI interaction and actual chat injection require a connected device.
